name: vortex-ps5
description: Vortex - PS5 Homebrew and Game Store

scripts.test: npm run test:vortex && npm run test:catalog && npm run test:app && npm run test:framework
scripts.test:vortex: python3 custom/vortex/validate.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s custom/vortex/tests -p "test_*.py" && npm run test:parity && node --test custom/vortex/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:framework: cd ps5-react && CC=clang CXX=clang++ npm test
